title: AWS Academy Graduate - Cloud Foundations
issuer: Amazon Web Services Training and Certification
summary: Foundations of AWS Cloud: core services, architecture principles, pricing, and support models.
body: Covers the fundamentals of cloud computing on AWS — core services, basic architecture and security principles, pricing and billing models, and the AWS support ecosystem. Earned through the AWS Academy in 2026.

title: AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials
issuer: Amazon Web Services Training and Certification
summary: Foundational AWS cloud training covering core services, security, architecture, pricing, and cloud concepts.
body: Covers the fundamental concepts of AWS Cloud, including core services, security, architecture, pricing, and support. Completed through AWS Training and Certification in 2026.

title: AWS Security Fundamentals
issuer: Amazon Web Services Training and Certification
summary: Fundamentals of securing AWS environments, including core security concepts, services, and best practices.
body: Covers foundational AWS security concepts, including security best practices, core AWS security services, and approaches to protecting cloud environments. Completed through AWS Training & Certification in August 2026.

title: AWS Educate - Getting Started with Security - Training Badge
issuer: Amazon Web Services Training and Certification
summary: Foundational AWS security training covering IAM and core AWS security services.
body: Covers foundational AWS security concepts, including AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) and additional AWS security services. Earned through AWS Educate in 2026.

title: Machine Learning Foundations
issuer: Amazon Web Services Training and Certification
summary: Foundations of machine learning, including core concepts, terminology, workflows, and practical applications.
body: Introduces fundamental machine learning concepts, terminology, workflows, and practical applications, providing a foundation for understanding how machine learning systems are developed and used. Completed through AWS Training and Certification in 2026.

title: Fundamentals of Generative AI
issuer: Amazon Web Services Training and Certification
summary: Foundations of generative AI, including core concepts, applications, and responsible use.
body: Introduces the foundations of generative artificial intelligence, including key concepts, capabilities, applications, and responsible approaches to using generative AI. Completed through AWS Training and Certification in 2026.

title: Introduction to Modern AI
summary: Foundations of modern artificial intelligence: core concepts, applications, and responsible use.
body: An introduction to how modern AI systems work and where they are applied — machine learning concepts, practical use cases, and responsible AI considerations. Earned through the Cisco Networking Academy in 2026.

title: Security and Connectivity Support
summary: Supporting secure network connectivity: network fundamentals, security basics, and connectivity troubleshooting.
body: Focuses on keeping users securely connected — network fundamentals, common security threats and mitigations, and systematic troubleshooting of connectivity problems. Earned through the Cisco Networking Academy in 2026.

title: IT Customer Support Basics
summary: Fundamentals of IT customer support: troubleshooting workflows, communication, and service best practices.
body: Covers the core skills of front-line IT support — diagnosing common hardware and software issues, walking users through fixes, and communicating clearly under pressure. Earned through the Cisco Networking Academy in 2026.
